mapper.select: SELECT batch.requisition_plan_id, material.id as mid, batch.id, batch.cargo_merge_code AS material_merge_code, batch.cargo_name AS materialName, batch.inventory_batch_no AS materialBatchNo, batch.unit_id AS unitId, batch.quantity AS outboundQuantity, case when (COUNT(DISTINCT material.cargo_position_id) = 1) then material.cargo_position_id else null end as cargoPositionId, case when (SUM(ISNULL(material.cargo_position_id)) = 0) then true else false end as receiveCompleted from bm_requisition_received_batch batch left join bm_requisition_received_material material on batch.id = material.received_batch_id WHERE batch.requisition_plan_id = #{requisitionPlanId} group by batch.id

select t1.id,t1.requisition_plan_id,t1.inventory_batch_id,t1.inventory_batch_no,t1.inventory_batch_no, t1.factory_batch_no,t1.expired_date,t1.hydration,t1.no_hydration_content,t1.report_no,t1.licence_no, t1.cargo_merge_code,t1.formula_material_id,SUM(t2.quantity) as receivedQuantity,t2.unit_id, MIN(t2.update_time) receive_time from bm_requisition_received_batch t1 left join bm_requisition_received_material t2 on t1.id = t2.received_batch_id WHERE t1.requisition_plan_id = #{requisitionPlanId} and t2.cargo_position_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t1.id ORDER BY receive_time ASC
